name: agent-config

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Shows the progress of the task the session is working on at the right of the footer

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons. By Anthropic, pinned to a reviewed commit.

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another open chat changed in the last 30 minutes, and offers to move the work to a worktree. By Nate Herk, pinned to a reviewed commit.

description: Mods of Claude Code written for this setup
